After 8 weeks, the group employing the internal focus showed significantly greater increases in elbow flexor muscle thickness compared to the external-focus group (12.4% vs. 6.9%, respectively); in contrast, similar hypertrophic changes were observed between conditions for the quadriceps. We speculated that the differences between muscles may be a function of their use in everyday life.
